test.create(first_source)
test.create(first_source::/first_child)
test.create(second_source)
test.create(second_source::/second_child)
test.move(first_source, /worker::input)
test.move(second_source, /worker::reserve)
test.create(/worker::run)
worker.destroy(input::/first_child)
worker.destroy(input)
worker.move(reserve, input)
worker.destroy(input::/second_child)
worker.destroy(input)
test.destroy(/worker::run)
